conviction_note: Two small findings pointing opposite ways on different lines. The Q2 ton-km acceleration argues EBITDA is above the weak Q2 2025 base, but Q1 showed about +10% ton-km turning into -1.6% revenue and -8% EBITDA. The net-result headline, by contrast, is set up to compare badly against an H1 2025 figure flattered by a one-off reversal of write-downs. They sum to -0.3. No consensus bar exists and there is no positioning anchor, so nothing here earns more than a small number. The equity is really priced on the restructuring and dilution path, and none of that resolves inside the window.
bar: unsourced. Baseline consensus is 1 analyst with no EPS estimate (Yahoo quoteSummary). The only company statement is the 2025-2031 restructuring strategy's full-year line 'Grupa od 2026 roku odzyskuje rentowność na poziomie wyniku netto' (https://www.pkpcargo.com/raporty_biezace/zatwierdzenie-przez-rade-nadzorcza-strategii-restrukturyzacyjnej-grupy-kapitalowej-pkp-cargo-na-lata-2025-2031/, 2026-04-28). That is a full-year aim and not an H1 bar, so every size is capped small.
session_check: amc, NOT the defaulted bmo. The issuer's own IR calendar lists 'Consolidated semiannual report of PKP CARGO Capital Group for HI 2026' on 28.09.2026 (https://www.pkpcargo.com/en/investor-relations/calendar/). Current report 1/2026 gives the same date (https://www.pkpcargo.com/en/raporty_biezace/publication-dates-of-periodic-reports-in-2026/). No later current report moves it: I checked the 2026 list through 77/2026 of 16/09. PKP CARGO files its periodic reports after the 17:00 Warsaw close. H1 2025 went out 30.09.2025 at 17:08 (https://pap-mediaroom.pl/biznes-i-finanse/pkp-cargo-sa-w-restrukturyzacji-raport-okresowy-polroczny-za-2025-psr) and the stock moved +7.33% on 2025-10-01. Q1 2026 went out on the evening of 2026-05-29 (Bankier stamp 21:07, https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/PKP-CARGO-S-A-W-RESTRUKTURYZACJI-Wyniki-finansowe-QSr-1-2026-9142747.html) and the reaction came on 2026-06-01. FY2025 went out at 00:09 on 2026-04-29. So the reaction window is close 2026-09-28 -> close 2026-09-29. The bmo window (Fri 09-25 close -> Mon 09-28 close) contains no print.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The KNF short register returns 403, and gpw.pl and espi.pap.pl are shut to this container. No disclosed net short position is known, which is not the same as zero. priced_lean_pct (+0.176) is the 20-day run-up (-3.52%) alone, which is the free control, and this name's print can never be confirmed or killed after the fact.

findings.finding: PKP CARGO's Q2 2026 ton-km looks to be up about +19% YoY, from about +10% in Q1. The cumulative headlines read as falling share (mass share YTD 27.84% after March, 27.13% after June), and that masks the Q2 year-on-year gain. Derived from UTK cumulative shares times market totals: Q2 2026 about 3.96bn tkm against about 3.34bn in Q2 2025, and Q2 mass share about 26.5% against about 25.1%. The Q2 2025 EBITDA base it lands on is weak at 65.4m PLN (H1 140.2m less Q1 74.8m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent on an EBITDA surprise. H1 2025 was +7.33% on 2025-10-01 on a net-profit headline. FY2025 was +4.41% on 2026-04-29. Q3 2025 was about 0% on 2025-12-01. Q1 2026 was -14.19% on 2026-06-01, confounded because debt-to-equity conversion and a rights issue at 12 PLN were announced the same evening.
findings.original_quote: Udział PKP Cargo w rynku przewiezionych towarów według masy wzrósł po czerwcu do 27,13 proc. całego rynku wobec 26,00 proc. po czerwcu 2025 roku ... Według pracy przewozowej udział PKP Cargo wyniósł po czerwcu 27,33 proc. vs 25,24 proc. rok wcześniej. (PKP Cargo's share of the market by mass rose to 27.13% after June against 26.00% a year earlier; by transport work (ton-km) its share was 27.33% against 25.24%.)
findings.why_not_priced: Each monthly PAP wire reports a cumulative share that has fallen month after month since March. It is never de-cumulated into a quarterly volume, so the Q2 acceleration shows up in no headline. With one analyst and no published estimate there is no consensus EBITDA to carry it. If it were priced, the stock would not sit 13% below the 12 PLN rights-issue floor with a -3.5% 20-day drift into the print. That said, the drawdown is more plausibly dilution than operations, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Same UTK series from different PAP months. Mass after March 2026 was 27.65% (revised to 27.84%) against 26.91%, and ton-km 28.31% against 25.93%: https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Udzial-PKP-Cargo-w-rynku-przewiezionych-towarow-wg-masy-wzrosl-rdr-po-III-do-27-65-proc-UTK-9125670.html. Market totals for H1 2026 (107.4mt, +2.3%): https://www.rynek-kolejowy.pl/wiadomosci/przewozy-towarowe-czwarty-z-rzedu-miesiac-poprawy-polrocze-na-plusie-153927.html. Against it: the company's own Q1 form shows revenue of 924.7m against 939.6m on about +10% ton-km (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/PKP-CARGO-S-A-W-RESTRUKTURYZACJI-Wyniki-finansowe-QSr-1-2026-9142747.html). Volume is being bought with price, and that is why the size is cut.

findings.finding: The H1 2026 net result will be compared against an H1 2025 figure (-17.9m PLN) that contained a Q2 2025 net profit of +30.7m. StockWatch attributed that profit mainly to a reversal of write-downs (odwrócenie odpisów). With Q1 2026 already at -45.8m, H1 2026 matches last year only if Q2 2026 nets more than about +28m, so the likely wire headline is a wider half-year loss. That would also sit awkwardly against the strategy's line that the group returns to net profit in 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time the net headline surprised was H1 2025: the one-off-driven Q2 profit printed and the stock rose +7.33% on 2025-10-01 on 354k shares, against about 30k typical. So this name has reacted to the headline net number rather than to its quality.
findings.original_quote: Zysk jest, ale głównie dzięki one-off. Tak naprawdę dodatni wynik zawdzięczamy odwróceniu odpisów (There is a profit, but mainly thanks to a one-off. In truth the positive result is owed to the reversal of write-downs)
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes an H1 net estimate for this name: the baseline shows 1 analyst and a null estimate. The prior-year one-off is a year-old footnote, not something a wire comparison adjusts for. If the market had already framed H1 2026 against a clean base, there would be sell-side or press previews saying so, and I found none. Still, Q1's -45.8m is public and the stock is at 52-week lows, so a good part of 'still loss-making' is already in the price. Hence the small size.
findings.independence: H1 2025 figures (EBIT 54.7m, net -17.9m, Q2 net +30.7m) from a different outlet: https://kolejowyportal.pl/grupa-pkp-cargo-przedstawila-wyniki-za-i-polrocze-2025-roku/. Q1 2026 net -45.8m: https://kolejowyportal.pl/pkp-cargo-podsumowalo-pierwszy-kwartal-2026-roku/. The strategy line on net profitability in 2026: https://www.pkpcargo.com/raporty_biezace/zatwierdzenie-przez-rade-nadzorcza-strategii-restrukturyzacyjnej-grupy-kapitalowej-pkp-cargo-na-lata-2025-2031/. This does not contradict finding 1: EBITDA can rise year on year while net falls against a base that one-off reversals flattered.

outside_window.finding: The creditors' council's opinion on the 15 September arrangement proposals, and the deadline for competing proposals from parties other than PKP CARGO or the administrator, both fall on 2026-10-15. The creditor vote follows. This is the event that actually sets the equity's fate.

Series N rights issue of 75.0-89.6m shares at the higher of 12.00 PLN or 80% of the 50-session VWAP ending 2026-12-16. That floor is above today's 10.42 spot, so on current prices the rights are out of the money. Add 29.4m series D shares converting Group IV state-railway claims at 12 PLN (44.8m -> 74.2m shares before N) and warrants letting PKP S.A. hold 25-33.34%. The dilution is known and was announced on 2026-05-29/06-23.

The PLN 1.52bn 'coal decision' damages claim against the State Treasury. The regional court resumed it and suspended it again on 2026-09-15 for settlement talks, and the 15/09 proposals hand 50% of any net recovery to creditor groups I, III and IV. It is undated and, as a contingent asset, will not appear in the H1 balance sheet.

Rescheduling of the 28.09.2026 date: no current report after 12/01 changes it, and the IR calendar page was modified 2026-08-19 and still shows 28.09.

baseline_tension: Mostly orthogonal to the lean. The findings sit on the quality of the half-year print, not on the -3.5% 20-day and -7.5% 60-day drift, which is dilution-driven. The small negative net agrees weakly with the drift and the small positive cuts against it.
language_note: Session timing came only from Polish sources. PAP MediaRoom and Bankier timestamps show PKP CARGO files periodic reports after the 17:00 close (17:08, about 21:07, 00:09), which moves the window to 28 close -> 29 close. The English IR calendar gives the date only.

The UTK per-operator mass and ton-km shares with year-earlier comparisons, which the Q2 de-cumulation rests on, appear only in Polish PAP wire copy on Bankier. The English trade press (RailFreight, The Rail Agenda) covers the restructuring, not the monthly volumes.
The attribution of the Q2 2025 profit to a reversal of write-downs ('odwrócenie odpisów') appears only in StockWatch.pl commentary. English coverage found reports the headline profit only.

The full current-report text (the 50% coal-claim sharing, the 12 PLN conversion list, the 15 October council deadline) is in Polish on the IR site. RailFreight carried the gist in English behind a paywall, so on the restructuring the English sources did carry the substance.
lessons_applied: 'A narrow proxy loses to ... a company-level number in a primary document': the company's own Q1 form showed about +10% ton-km turning into -1.6% revenue and -8% EBITDA, so the de-cumulated UTK finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and its low end widened to -1.0.
'The session is the single most load-bearing field': this was already settled during the hunt (amc, window 28->29 Sep), and the file confirmed it takes priority; no size change.
'Keep findings inside the exit window': the creditor-council deadline (15 Oct), the rights-issue pricing (16 Dec) and the coal claim stay in outside_window at 0.

'Two findings that cannot both be true': checked. EBITDA up year on year and the net headline down against a one-off base can both be true, so both are kept; the net-headline finding was trimmed from -0.7 to -0.6 because Q1's loss is already public.
